stations.title: Records
stations.text: Dictionaries typed by hand, open to change

captions: Rhona plans the searches and asks where the teams take their bearings from.
Today the records are dictionaries, and one wrong line can move the base itself.
You write dataclasses for a callout, a search with its own teams, and a grid reference.
Now the base's grid reference cannot change, and every bearing starts from it.
Every record prints and compares itself, and what must stay put stays put.
